items.q: They... Cecil de Mille's and oldtimers William...I don't know--they would give their actors...put them in the mood.

ctx.x: ...and go out there. And the only person... people who ever heard this music were the people working on the film 'cause it was for their...it was for the actors and actresses.

Yeah. It wasn't recorded. It was atmosphere, see? If you was gonna do a sad thing or somethin' where's people cry, you play hearts-and-flowers or something like that, you know. They... Cecil de Mille's and oldtimers William...I don't know--they would give their actors...put them in the mood.
And as a result of playing in the studios like this, you probably got more jobs playing for what? Parties and things?
